term: eternal (ST I q.10; Lean parameter `Eternal` of `GodIsEternal`)
definition: `Eternal g`: g is eternal in the sense of ST I q.10: without beginning, end or succession, as eternity follows immutability the way time follows motion. In stage 2 group 1 (#198) the predicate is opaque: CATHOLICISM-STAGE2-CLASSICAL-ATTRIBUTES accepts any predicate under this name, so nothing proved there depends on its content.
note: Stage 2 group 2 (#199) gives it content for God through ST I q.10 a.2: what is altogether immutable is eternal.
